thread:
ava_csm: Tailwind (NZ pilot) asked for a last-minute demo window tomorrow 09:00 NZDT. Requirements: temporary egress allowlist for partner IPs, route QPS bump to 1800, mTLS client cert pinning, and region lock to NZ. Can we do a 6h window? cc @drew_sre @sam_net

drew_sre: We can. Need public NAT CIDRs and whether traffic is bursty vs sustained. Also confirm retention: auto-revoke or manual?

sam_net: Partner sent 203.0.114.77/32 and 203.0.114.78/32. Traffic is bursty (many short gen calls), occasional long polling. They want region_pin nz-south.

olivia_support: Legal OK with temporary access. They asked that we mute non-critical alert noise for the window. Also capture demo outcome in account notes for renewal signal.

ops_bot: Policy reminder: temporary allowlists max 72h; default expiry = now + 24h unless specified. Region pin supported. Cert uploads must use the secrets API; CN pattern allowed. Example commands:
```
redwoodctl allowlist create --name tailwind-demo-temp --cidrs 203.0.114.77/32,203.0.114.78/32 --expires 2026-03-26T02:00:00Z --regions nz-south --note "Tailwind demo; auto-expire"
redwoodctl route update --route tailwind-demo --qps 1800 --region_pin nz-south
```

drew_sre: I'll apply the allowlist and perform an NGINX canary for mTLS verify_client. I'll schedule alert suppression scoped to ticket CS-4810 for non-P0 alerts during the window. If error rate >4% or p95 latency >300ms we auto-revoke.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started: edge-proxy/mTLS-check #4120 -> status: started (ETA ~4m)

ava_csm: Partner confirmed cert CN = demo.tailwind.partner and will upload PEM in 8 mins. Can we extend expiry to 6h? They requested 6 hours exactly from start.

ods: (typo ignore)

ops_bot: Allowlist slot reserved AL-10177. To extend to 6h, set --expires to 2026-03-26T06:00:00Z in CLI. Note: auto-revoke will run at expiry.

drew_sre: Applying allowlist now and setting route override. Ticket CS-4810 created. Will post links when changes are live.

ops_bot: Allowlist applied: AL-10177. Rules: 203.0.114.77/32,203.0.114.78/32. Expires 2026-03-26T06:00:00Z. Route override: tailwind-demo qps=1800 region_pin=nz-south. Alert suppression active for CS-4810 (non-P0 only). Auto-revoke scheduled.

deploy-bot: canary passed; rolling to prod edge in 2m.

ava_csm: Great, I'll send the connection details and the rollback criteria (revoke if errors >4% or p95 >300ms). Adding a renewal note: onboarding speed + successful demo increases renewal likelihood.

drew_sre: Linked deploy logs and CS ticket. Closing unless extension requested.

ava_csm: Thanks team, leaving open until demo completes. :sparkles:
